med_findings.status: confirmed MED by round-1 agent-1, round-2 agent-3, and the discarded partial agent-1 — three independent reviewers
med_findings.title: GET gated by hiring-team show? but POST regenerate gated by org-wide update_ai_settings?/can_use_ai_credits? — a non-hiring-team org member (with hiring_team_ai_credits_control_enabled) can POST a paid regeneration on a job they cannot GET
med_findings.classification: do-not-fix: code matches SPEC §9 literally (no spec-impl mismatch), and it is analog-consistent (the AI-summary single-create and bulk-create controllers share the identical asymmetry — reads gate on hiring-team, paid writes gate on org-wide can_use_ai_credits?). Product-awareness item for Jessica.
med_findings.doc_note: round-2 agent-3: SPEC §9 cites jobs_controller.rb:163 as the analog, but that update_ai_settings? call sits behind a preceding bare `authorize job` (update?/on_hiring_team?) at line 162, making jobs_controller#update STRICTER than this endpoint. The truer analogs are the AI-summary create controllers, which do share the asymmetry. Doc imprecision only; does not change correctness or severity.

med_findings.status: confirmed MED + proven pre-existing by round-2 agent-1 (git blame -> commit a5c0e1f823, 2026-04-15; feature's only change to the file is the +5/-1 validation hunk)
med_findings.title: Two PRE-EXISTING paths in BulkGenerateAiSummariesJob#each_iteration (StandardError catch-all + job-application-not-found early return) leave the claim row :processing, contradicting the file's header comment
med_findings.classification: do-not-fix: pre-existing, out of feature scope. The feature's ADDED validation-failure path correctly sets :failed (adjudicated flag 6) and does not funnel through either pre-existing path.

med_findings.title: react-query v3.13.10: isError can coexist with retained stale data, so a transient background-refetch failure renders the 'Could not load job criteria' error state over an already-populated criteria card (hiding the card + its action buttons) until the next successful refetch or a reload
med_findings.classification: do-not-fix: the code matches the conventions-pass-adjudicated precedence exactly (query-error state has priority after isLoading and before all payload states — an unconditional isError check). This is that adjudicated design working as specified; whether isError should suppress cached data is a design/product decision about react-query behavior, not a spec-implementation mismatch. Auto-recovers on next refetch. Surfaced for Jessica's awareness.

low_findings_summary: 10 LOW across round-2 agents — all analog-consistent / pre-existing / spec-verbatim / cosmetic observations (unmemoized serializer re-reads with self-correcting torn-read window; unguarded .job.title deref unreachable due to FK; spec-accepted §4.1 pending-window double-enqueue; isFetching-folded-into-isInFlight cosmetic button flicker; static-list index keys; etc.).
